name: [BETA] Lone Survival
desc:
Explore the island of what once was a Shadow Government facility location in Japan. Survive and scavenge through the ruins, manage your calories and thirst, and construct a living quarter... kill or be killed. The island embodies the principle of survival of the fittest - do you have what it takes? 

Last Full Wipe: 10/16/2026 - 2:00PM CST
Last Weekly Wipe: 10/23/2026 - 4:00PM CST

Playable Devices: PC, XBOX, PS4, & PS5

Account age must be at least 15 days to play.
